all_arms_army_corps.name: Army Corps
all_arms_army_corps.observation: Two or three divisions, each with its own guns and horse, march on separate roads under one corps commander and meet for battle.
all_arms_army_corps.ability_reason: A general can command a corps of several divisions as one body, each marching on its own road and converging for battle, so far larger armies can be handled in the field.

class_year_conscription.name: Class-Year Conscription
class_year_conscription.observation: Every young man of the year's class is entered on the rolls, drawn, examined and sent to his regiment.
class_year_conscription.ability_reason: Every man of a year-class is called up and trained, so a general can draw on a trained mass that replaces its losses year after year.
class_year_conscription.social_consequence: Every family gives a son; there are draft riots in the towns and deserters in the hills.

rifle_skirmisher_battalions.name: Rifle Skirmishers
rifle_skirmisher_battalions.observation: Green-coated riflemen spread out in pairs ahead of the line and pick off officers at long range.

spherical_case_shot.name: Case Shot
spherical_case_shot.observation: A hollow ball packed with musket balls bursts in the air over the enemy ranks, timed by a cut fuse.

economic_blockade_decrees.name: Blockade Decrees
economic_blockade_decrees.observation: A decree closes every port of the continent to the enemy's ships and goods.
economic_blockade_decrees.social_consequence: Smugglers flourish, and the port towns on both sides go hungry.

guerrilla_band_warfare.name: Guerrilla Bands
guerrilla_band_warfare.observation: Bands of peasants and deserters ambush the occupier's couriers and convoys and vanish into the hills.
guerrilla_band_warfare.social_consequence: The occupier burns villages in reprisal, and hatred outlives the war.

staff_war_college.name: Staff War College
staff_war_college.observation: Selected officers spend two years at the war college, studying past campaigns, maps, railways and supply.
staff_war_college.ability_reason: Staff officers trained at the war college plan marches, supply and mobilization, so a general's intentions are turned into timed movements for a whole army.

percussion_cap_ignition.name: Percussion Caps
percussion_cap_ignition.observation: A copper cap struck by the hammer fires the charge in a downpour that would drown a flintlock's pan.
percussion_cap_ignition.ability_reason: Muskets fire in rain and wind with few misfires, so a general's infantry can fight in any weather.

coast_guard_service.name: Coast Guard
coast_guard_service.observation: Coast guard stations watch every cove for smugglers and wrecks, with a boat and a rocket line ready.

naval_shell_guns.name: Naval Shell Guns
naval_shell_guns.observation: Flat-firing guns throw explosive shells that burst inside a wooden hull and set her afire.

volunteer_lifeboat_rescue.name: Lifeboat Crews
volunteer_lifeboat_rescue.observation: Fishermen launch the lifeboat into a gale at the sound of the maroon and row out to the wreck.

masonry_casemate_forts.name: Casemate Forts
masonry_casemate_forts.observation: Tiers of guns in vaulted granite casemates cover the harbour mouth from a fort on the shoal.

uniformed_beat_police.name: Uniformed Police
uniformed_beat_police.observation: Constables in blue coats walk fixed beats day and night, each timed to pass the same corner every quarter hour.
uniformed_beat_police.ability_reason: Uniformed police walk fixed beats day and night, so crime is prevented and disorder is handled by the civil power instead of soldiers.
uniformed_beat_police.social_consequence: Street folk and radicals learn to fear the constables, and the parish watchmen are pensioned off.

paddle_steam_warships.name: Paddle Warships
paddle_steam_warships.observation: A paddle frigate tows the ships of the line into position against the wind.

war_as_policy_doctrine.name: War as Policy
war_as_policy_doctrine.observation: Staff lecturers teach that war serves the aims of the state, and that a general who forgets the aim can win battles and lose the war.

rural_constabulary.name: County Constabulary
rural_constabulary.observation: County police in every market town patrol the lanes and farms the old parish constable could never reach.

revolving_pistols.name: Revolvers
revolving_pistols.observation: A pistol with a turning cylinder fires six shots without reloading.

detached_fort_rings.name: Detached Fort Rings
detached_fort_rings.observation: A ring of separate forts, miles out from the old walls, keeps an enemy's siege guns out of range of the town.

needle_breech_rifle.name: Needle Rifle
needle_breech_rifle.observation: Soldiers load the needle rifle at the breech while lying down, firing five shots to the muzzle-loader's one.

detective_branch.name: Detectives
detective_branch.observation: Plain-clothes officers investigate crimes after the fact, keep records of known thieves and follow suspects.

screw_steam_warships.name: Screw Warships
screw_steam_warships.observation: Warships driven by a screw below the waterline keep their full broadside and can steam against the wind.

expanding_base_bullet.name: Expanding-Base Bullet
expanding_base_bullet.observation: An elongated bullet with a hollow base drops easily down the rifled barrel and expands on firing to grip the grooves.
expanding_base_bullet.ability_reason: Rifles load as fast as muskets and kill at several hundred paces, so a general must open his ranks and use cover; close-order columns become death traps.

engineer_demonstration_ranges.observation: At the engineers' ranges new charges, bridges and entrenchments are tested in front of the officers who will use them.

range_estimation_drill.observation: A musketry school drills rifle companies to judge distance, set their sights and fire only aimed shots.

field_telegraph_trains.name: Field Telegraph
field_telegraph_trains.observation: Wagons unreel telegraph wire behind the advancing army, and headquarters talks to every corps within the hour.

armored_hulls.observation: Steam warships clad in iron plate take the enemy's shot and shell without harm.
armored_hulls.ability_reason: An admiral's ironclads shrug off shot that would sink wooden ships, so wooden fleets become obsolete in a single action.

railway_mobilization.name: Railway Mobilization
railway_mobilization.observation: Troop trains leave the depots by timetable, and whole army corps reach the frontier in days.
railway_mobilization.ability_reason: A general's army reaches the frontier by rail timetable in days instead of weeks, arriving fresh and supplied, so whoever mobilizes first can strike first.
railway_mobilization.social_consequence: The railways are taken over for war and civilian traffic stops.

rifled_breech_artillery.name: Rifled Breech-Loaders
rifled_breech_artillery.observation: Rifled guns load at the breech and throw pointed shells farther and truer than any smoothbore.

metallic_cartridges.observation: A brass case holds powder, primer and bullet together, sealed against the weather.
metallic_cartridges.ability_reason: Soldiers carry sealed cartridges that keep dry and load in a moment, so breech-loaders and repeaters fire as fast as a man can work the action.

magazine_repeating_rifles.name: Repeating Rifles
magazine_repeating_rifles.observation: A lever throws a fresh cartridge from the tube magazine into the chamber, and a rifleman fires a dozen shots without reloading.

revolving_gun_turrets.name: Gun Turrets
revolving_gun_turrets.observation: A low-sided warship carries her heavy guns in an armoured turret that turns to fire in any direction.

field_army_war_rules.name: Rules of War
field_army_war_rules.observation: Every officer receives printed orders on how prisoners, the wounded and civilians in occupied country must be treated.

steam_fire_brigades.name: Steam Fire Brigades
steam_fire_brigades.observation: A paid brigade gallops to the fire with a steam pump that throws water over a four-storey roof.

crank_volley_guns.name: Volley Guns
crank_volley_guns.observation: A soldier turns a crank and a ring of barrels fires in turn, faster than a company of riflemen.

naval_torpedoes.observation: A self-propelled torpedo runs beneath the surface and bursts against the hull below the armour.

stable_blasting_explosive.name: Stable High Explosive
stable_blasting_explosive.observation: Nitroglycerine soaked into earth and rolled into sticks can be carried and dropped, and still blows rock apart.
stable_blasting_explosive.ability_reason: Engineers can blast rock, bridges and works with safe, stable charges, so a general's sappers demolish and breach in hours instead of days.

reserve_mobilization_plans.name: Reserve Mobilization
reserve_mobilization_plans.observation: Every reservist keeps his papers at home, and a single telegram sends him to his depot on a fixed day of the mobilization.
reserve_mobilization_plans.ability_reason: Reservists called by telegraph join their regiments within days by plan, so a general's peacetime army swells several-fold at the start of a war.

examined_officer_commissions.name: Examined Commissions
examined_officer_commissions.observation: Commissions are no longer bought; candidates sit written examinations and are ranked by merit.

political_police_bureau.name: Political Police
political_police_bureau.observation: A bureau of the police opens letters, pays informers and keeps files on every dissenter.
political_police_bureau.social_consequence: Informers sit in every coffee house; dissenters are exiled or fall silent.

automatic_actions.observation: The recoil of each shot works the action of the next, and a single gun fires hundreds of rounds a minute.
automatic_actions.ability_reason: A single gun crew fires hundreds of rounds a minute, so a general's defended line can stop a massed assault cold.

naval_war_college.name: Naval War College
naval_war_college.observation: Captains study fleet actions of the past and fight war games on the floor of the naval college.

smokeless_propellant.name: Smokeless Powder
smokeless_propellant.observation: Rifles fire without the white cloud that betrayed every shooter, and bullets fly faster and flatter.
smokeless_propellant.ability_reason: Rifles and guns fire without betraying smoke and at higher velocity, so a general's riflemen and hidden batteries can fight unseen.

sea_power_doctrine.name: Sea Power Doctrine
sea_power_doctrine.observation: A naval scholar argues from history that whoever commands the sea decides the war and the trade.

torpedo_boat_destroyers.name: Destroyers
torpedo_boat_destroyers.observation: Fast, lightly built destroyers screen the battle fleet against torpedo boats.

fingerprint_identification.name: Fingerprints
fingerprint_identification.observation: A print left on a window sill is matched to a card in the police files, and the burglar is hanged by his fingertips.

recoil_absorbing_field_gun.name: Quick-Firing Field Gun
recoil_absorbing_field_gun.observation: The barrel recoils on a cylinder of oil and springs back into place, and the gun stays laid on its target.
recoil_absorbing_field_gun.ability_reason: Field guns stay laid on target after each shot, so a battery fires many aimed rounds a minute and a general's artillery can dominate the field.

indirect_fire.observation: Batteries behind a hill fire on map coordinates, corrected by an observer who can see the target.
indirect_fire.ability_reason: Batteries shell targets they cannot see, directed by observers and maps, so a general can mass fire from hidden guns on any point of the front.

barbed_wire_entanglements.name: Barbed Wire
barbed_wire_entanglements.observation: Belts of barbed wire staked in front of the trenches hold attackers under fire.

land_war_conventions.name: Land War Conventions
land_war_conventions.observation: The realms sign conventions on how prisoners, the wounded and occupied towns must be treated in war.

submersible_hulls.observation: A submarine dives, runs unseen beneath the surface and surfaces to recharge.
submersible_hulls.ability_reason: An admiral's submarines can strike warships and merchantmen unseen, so no sea lane is safe without escorts.

field_telephone_lines.name: Field Telephones
field_telephone_lines.observation: A forward observer telephones corrections to the battery, and the next shell lands on the target.

naval_fire_control.observation: Range-finders and a plotting table in the fire-control room aim every gun of the ship at a target miles away.

all_big_gun_battleships.name: Battleships
all_big_gun_battleships.observation: A turbine battleship with ten great guns outranges and outruns every ship built before her.
all_big_gun_battleships.ability_reason: One battleship outguns whole older squadrons, so an admiral with a modern battle fleet can seek decisive action; every rival fleet is obsolete overnight.
all_big_gun_battleships.social_consequence: The battleship race swallows the budget.

machine_gun_companies.name: Machine-Gun Companies
machine_gun_companies.observation: Every regiment gets a company of machine guns, sited to sweep the ground before its trenches.

state_intelligence_service.name: Intelligence Service
state_intelligence_service.observation: A secret bureau runs agents abroad and reports only to the ruler.

naval_aviation.observation: Seaplanes scout ahead of the fleet and report the enemy's course by wireless.

aerial_bombardment.observation: Airplanes drop bombs on the enemy's trenches, railheads and depots.
aerial_bombardment.ability_reason: A general may bomb enemy armies, fleets and works in the field on his own authority; bombing a city needs the ruler's spoken decision in the Court.
aerial_bombardment.social_consequence: Towns within flying range dread the sound of engines at night.

continuous_trench_systems.name: Continuous Trenches
continuous_trench_systems.observation: Trench lines with dugouts and wire run unbroken from the sea to the mountains.
continuous_trench_systems.ability_reason: A general can hold a whole front with trenches, dugouts and wire, so attacks cost enormous casualties for little ground.
continuous_trench_systems.social_consequence: A generation of young men is lost in the mud.

fighter_tactics.observation: Fighter pilots fly in pairs and dive out of the sun at the enemy's spotting planes.

mountain_field_school.observation: Mountain troops learn to climb, ski and haul guns through high passes.

chemical_gas_warfare.name: War Gases
chemical_gas_warfare.observation: Clouds of choking gas drift from cylinders across no-man's-land; within weeks every soldier carries a gas mask.
chemical_gas_warfare.ability_reason: No general may use war gases on his own authority. Research makes it known, not usable: only the ruler's spoken decision in the Court can loose it, and the people and every other realm remember that decision.
chemical_gas_warfare.social_consequence: Blinded and coughing veterans come home, and gas becomes the byword for dishonourable war.

armored_vehicles.observation: Tracked, armoured vehicles with guns crawl over the wire and across the trenches.
armored_vehicles.ability_reason: Tracked armoured vehicles cross wire and trenches under fire, so a general can break a trench deadlock where infantry alone would die.

armor_piercing_weapons.observation: Hardened-core rounds and rifles for infantry pierce the plate of an armoured vehicle.

sound_flash_ranging.name: Sound and Flash Ranging
sound_flash_ranging.observation: Microphones and observers timing the flash and bang of each enemy gun plot its hidden position.

carrier_aviation.observation: Aircraft take off from and land on a flat-decked ship far out at sea.
carrier_aviation.social_consequence: The admirals of the battleships fight the new service for every ton of steel.

escorted_convoy_system.name: Escorted Convoys
escorted_convoy_system.observation: Merchant ships sail together in convoy, ringed by destroyers, and the submarines find the empty sea.

infiltration_storm_squads.name: Storm Squads
infiltration_storm_squads.observation: Small squads with light machine guns and grenades slip through weak points and bypass the strongholds.

engineer_infantry_security.observation: Engineers and infantry clear mines, bridge rivers and hold the crossings together.

infantry_tank_cooperation.observation: Infantry advance behind the tanks and clear the machine-gun nests the tanks point out.

mechanized_crew_school.observation: Crews learn to drive, maintain and fight their vehicles as one team.

underwater_sound_ranging.name: Underwater Sound Ranging
underwater_sound_ranging.observation: An escort sends out pings and hears their echo from a submarine hiding below.

independent_air_arm.name: Independent Air Arm
independent_air_arm.observation: The airmen become a service of their own beside the army and navy, with their own ministry and doctrine.

naval_arms_limitation.name: Naval Arms Limitation
naval_arms_limitation.observation: The realms agree on a ratio of battleships each may keep, and half-built hulls are scrapped on the slips.

gas_germ_weapon_ban.name: Gas and Germ Weapon Ban
gas_germ_weapon_ban.observation: The realms sign a treaty never to use gas or germs in war, though many keep stocks to answer in kind.

mobile_radio_command.name: Radio Command Nets
mobile_radio_command.observation: Every tank and command car carries a radio, and the commander speaks to his whole division on the move.

rotor_cipher_machines.name: Rotor Cipher Machines
rotor_cipher_machines.observation: A typewriter-like machine with turning rotors scrambles every letter, a new setting each day.

rotary_wing.observation: A machine lifted by turning blades rises straight up, hovers and lands in a clearing.

radio_detection_ranging.name: Radar
radio_detection_ranging.observation: Radio echoes reveal aircraft and ships far beyond sight, day and night, through cloud and fog.
radio_detection_ranging.ability_reason: Radio echoes find aircraft and ships beyond sight by day or night, so a general or admiral is warned of an attack and can direct fighters and guns to meet it.

radio_patrol_emergency_line.name: Radio Patrols and Emergency Line
radio_patrol_emergency_line.observation: A caller dials one short number, and a radio patrol car is sent to the address within minutes.

civil_air_defence.name: Civil Air Defence
civil_air_defence.observation: Wardens enforce the blackout, sirens sound the raid and families file into shelters.

armoured_division.name: Armoured Division
armoured_division.observation: Tanks, motorized infantry and self-propelled guns train and fight together as one division.
armoured_division.ability_reason: Tanks, motor infantry and self-propelled guns fight as one division, so a general can break through and drive deep behind the enemy before a new line forms.

integrated_air_defence.name: Integrated Air Defence
integrated_air_defence.observation: Radar stations report to plotting rooms, where controllers direct each fighter squadron onto the incoming raid.
integrated_air_defence.ability_reason: Radar stations, plotting rooms and fighter control form one system, so a realm's air commander can meet every raid in strength.

airborne_operations.observation: Parachute troops and gliders land behind the enemy's lines to seize bridges and crossroads.

infantry_antitank_coordination.observation: Infantry with antitank guns and rockets hold their ground as the tanks come on.

machine_cryptanalysis.name: Machine Codebreaking
machine_cryptanalysis.observation: Rooms of whirring electromechanical machines test cipher settings until the enemy's daily key is broken.

naval_logistics.observation: Tankers and supply ships steam alongside the warships and pass fuel and stores while under way.

amphibious_landing_doctrine.name: Amphibious Landings
amphibious_landing_doctrine.observation: Landing craft run up the beach, drop their ramps and put tanks and infantry ashore under covering fire.

guided_weapons.observation: A missile steered by radio or by its own seeker homes on its target.

ballistic_rocket_bombardment.name: Long-Range Rockets
ballistic_rocket_bombardment.observation: Rockets fall from the upper air on a distant city without warning; they are too inaccurate to hit anything smaller.
ballistic_rocket_bombardment.social_consequence: The city under the rockets lives in fear of explosions that come without a sound.

fission_weapon.name: Fission Bomb
fission_weapon.observation: One bomb destroys a whole city in a flash of light, and the scientists who built it fall silent.
fission_weapon.ability_reason: No general may use the fission bomb on his own authority. Research makes it known, not usable: only the ruler's spoken decision in the Court can loose it, and the people and every other realm remember that decision.
fission_weapon.social_consequence: Every realm now knows that one bomb can end a city, and the fear never leaves.

unified_defence_ministry.name: Defence Ministry
unified_defence_ministry.observation: Army, navy and air force answer to one minister of defence and one joint staff.

standing_alliance_command.name: Alliance Command
standing_alliance_command.observation: Allied realms appoint a standing joint commander in peacetime, with a shared headquarters and plans.

swept_wing_jet_fighters.name: Jet Fighters
swept_wing_jet_fighters.observation: Swept-wing jet fighters with radar gunsights fly near the speed of sound.

thermonuclear_weapon.name: Thermonuclear Weapon
thermonuclear_weapon.observation: A test weapon a thousand times the fission bomb's power erases an island from the map.
thermonuclear_weapon.ability_reason: No general may use the thermonuclear weapon on his own authority. Research makes it known, not usable: only the ruler's spoken decision in the Court can loose it, and the people and every other realm remember that decision.
thermonuclear_weapon.social_consequence: Fallout from the tests reaches every realm, and the dread of a war that ends everything grows.

nuclear_propulsion.observation: A reactor drives a submarine for years without refuelling and keeps it submerged for months.

surface_to_air_missiles.name: Surface-to-Air Missiles
surface_to_air_missiles.observation: Radar-guided missiles rise from batteries around the cities to meet bombers at any height.

nuclear_civil_defence.name: Nuclear Civil Defence
nuclear_civil_defence.observation: Shelters are dug, evacuation routes signposted, and children drill hiding under their desks.
nuclear_civil_defence.social_consequence: Every child learns to fear the siren.

interrealm_peacekeepers.name: Peacekeepers
interrealm_peacekeepers.observation: Lightly armed soldiers of many realms, in the world assembly's colours, stand between two armies along a ceasefire line.

continuity_of_government.name: Continuity of Government
continuity_of_government.observation: A second seat of rule is hollowed out under a mountain, with its own power, water and radio.

intercontinental_missiles.name: Intercontinental Missiles
intercontinental_missiles.observation: Missiles in hardened silos can reach any city on earth within half an hour of launch.
intercontinental_missiles.ability_reason: No general may use the intercontinental missiles on his own authority. Research makes it known, not usable: only the ruler's spoken decision in the Court can loose it, and the people and every other realm remember that decision.
intercontinental_missiles.social_consequence: Every city on earth lies within half an hour of destruction, and the people know it.

reconnaissance_satellites.name: Reconnaissance Satellites
reconnaissance_satellites.observation: Cameras in orbit photograph the rival's bases, airfields and fleets and drop the film home in capsules.
reconnaissance_satellites.ability_reason: Cameras in orbit photograph the rival's bases, fields and fleets every few days, so the court and generals judge threats from dated evidence rather than rumour; they reveal only what the cameras saw.

deterrence_doctrine.name: Deterrence Doctrine
deterrence_doctrine.observation: Strategists argue that the bomb is for never using, and that a hardened command able to answer any attack keeps the peace.
deterrence_doctrine.ability_reason: Deterrence changes what the court must weigh, not what generals may do: the weapons stay under the ruler's spoken decision, and the threat of answer restrains rivals.

missile_submarine_patrols.name: Missile Submarines
missile_submarine_patrols.observation: Submarines carrying ballistic missiles slip out to sea and stay hidden for months, beyond the reach of any first strike.
missile_submarine_patrols.ability_reason: No general may use the missile submarines on his own authority. Research makes it known, not usable: only the ruler's spoken decision in the Court can loose it, and the people and every other realm remember that decision.

naval_missiles.observation: Ships fire missiles that skim the sea and strike an enemy far beyond gun range.

rival_capital_hotline.name: Crisis Hotline
rival_capital_hotline.observation: A direct line links the two rival capitals, so the rulers can speak before a mistake becomes a war.

nuclear_test_ban_treaties.name: Test-Ban Treaties
nuclear_test_ban_treaties.observation: The realms agree to test no more weapons in the open air, at sea or in space, and not to hand the bomb to others.
nuclear_test_ban_treaties.ability_reason: Treaties end open-air weapon tests and bind realms not to spread the bomb, so fallout stops and the court can weigh inspection instead of fear.

helicopter_air_assault.name: Helicopter Air Assault
helicopter_air_assault.observation: Helicopters carry a battalion over the jungle and set it down in a clearing behind the enemy.

night_vision_intensifiers.name: Night Vision
night_vision_intensifiers.observation: A sight that multiplies starlight lets the soldier see across the dark field in green.

launch_warning_satellites.name: Launch Warning Satellites
launch_warning_satellites.observation: Satellites watching for the heat of a rocket's exhaust give the capital half an hour's warning of any launch.

laser_guided_munitions.name: Laser-Guided Bombs
laser_guided_munitions.observation: A bomb steers itself onto a spot of laser light that a pilot or a soldier holds on the target.

biological_weapons_ban.name: Germ Weapons Ban
biological_weapons_ban.observation: The realms bind themselves never to make or stockpile germ weapons and to destroy what they hold.

counterterror_units.name: Counterterror Units
counterterror_units.observation: A small, highly trained unit storms a hijacked airliner and frees the hostages alive.

disaster_management_agency.name: Disaster Management Agency
disaster_management_agency.observation: A standing agency plans for floods, quakes and fires and runs the relief when they come.

remote_aircraft.observation: An unmanned aircraft flown from the ground circles over the battlefield for a day and sends back pictures.

stealth_aircraft.name: Stealth Aircraft
stealth_aircraft.observation: A black, angular aircraft reflects almost no radar echo and strikes before the defences know it is there.

tactical_data_links.name: Tactical Data Links
tactical_data_links.observation: Command posts, ships and aircraft share one picture of the battle through digital data links.

onsite_arms_inspection.name: On-Site Inspection
onsite_arms_inspection.observation: Inspectors from the rival realm watch the missiles cut apart and count those that remain.

satellite_guided_strike.name: Satellite-Guided Strike
satellite_guided_strike.observation: A bomb steered by satellite positioning falls through cloud onto a mapped target within a few metres.
satellite_guided_strike.ability_reason: Bombs and missiles guided by satellite positioning hit any mapped target in any weather, so a general can destroy bridges, depots and command posts with few sorties and less harm to what stands next to them.

chemical_weapons_convention.name: Chemical Weapons Convention
chemical_weapons_convention.observation: The realms agree to destroy every stock of war gas under inspection, and the old shells are burned in special furnaces.

town_camera_surveillance.name: Street Cameras
town_camera_surveillance.observation: Cameras on every corner of the town centre feed screens in a police control room.
town_camera_surveillance.social_consequence: Citizens are watched on every street; some feel safer, others no longer feel free.

antipersonnel_mine_ban.name: Mine Ban
antipersonnel_mine_ban.observation: The realms ban the mines that maim farmers long after the war, and demining teams clear the fields.

mass_signals_surveillance.name: Mass Signals Surveillance
mass_signals_surveillance.observation: The state copies every call and message crossing the cables and sifts them with computers.
mass_signals_surveillance.ability_reason: The state can intercept and sift the communications of whole populations, so plots and spies are uncovered, at the price of every citizen's privacy and the court's trust.
mass_signals_surveillance.social_consequence: When the scale of the interception is exposed, trust between the people and the state is badly damaged.

armed_remote_strike.name: Armed Remote Strike
armed_remote_strike.observation: A pilot thousands of miles away fires a missile from a circling unmanned aircraft.
armed_remote_strike.ability_reason: A general may use armed remote aircraft against enemy forces in the field; striking in a city needs the ruler's spoken decision in the Court.

biometric_border_documents.name: Biometric Borders
biometric_border_documents.observation: Passports carry a chip with the holder's face and fingerprints, checked by machine at the border.

cyber_defence_command.name: Cyber Defence Command
cyber_defence_command.observation: A command of programmers defends the realm's networks and can reach into an enemy's.
cyber_defence_command.ability_reason: A standing command defends the realm's networks and can sabotage an enemy's, so power grids, railways and banks are guarded like frontiers and a general's networked forces are harder to blind.

public_alert_broadcasts.name: Phone Alerts
public_alert_broadcasts.observation: Every pocket telephone in the district shrieks at once with a warning of flood or fire.

hypersonic_glide_vehicles.name: Hypersonic Glide Vehicles
hypersonic_glide_vehicles.observation: A warhead glides through the upper air at many times the speed of sound, weaving past the defences.
hypersonic_glide_vehicles.ability_reason: No general may use the hypersonic glide vehicles on his own authority. Research makes it known, not usable: only the ruler's spoken decision in the Court can loose it, and the people and every other realm remember that decision.

mass_small_drones.name: Swarms of Small Drones
mass_small_drones.observation: Cheap drones in the thousands hover over the front, and nothing that moves in the open survives for long.
mass_small_drones.ability_reason: Cheap drones in the thousands spot and strike at every point along the front, so a general's units cannot hide or mass unseen, and neither can the enemy's.

machine_assisted_targeting.name: Machine-Assisted Targeting
machine_assisted_targeting.observation: A machine sorts the camera feeds and proposes targets, and a named officer signs off each strike.
machine_assisted_targeting.ability_reason: The machine only proposes targets; a named commander must sign off each strike, and it never widens a general's authority.

directed_energy_point_defence.name: Directed-Energy Defence
directed_energy_point_defence.observation: A beam of light burns incoming drones out of the sky for the cost of the power it draws.
